description: Global AI lists slice 2, step 5 (context/designs/modding/global-ai-lists.md): the runner packs tests/fixtures/modpipe/ai-lists-bank into a .pdmod and enables it. Its .pdai carries global list 0x0000 (a byte-identical copy of the base list, written as args only: no operand bytes, ai-typed-operands.md), so a Complex match must take that one list from the mod bank and the other 45 from base:ai_global, with play unchanged.

input_sequence.comment: Pause until the local player of the Complex match is spawned and live.
scripted exit after a few frames of play

required_lines: AI\.GLOBAL: compiled the AI list bank '[^']+': 1 lists
AI\.GLOBAL: stage 0x[0-9a-f]+ runs the 46 global lists of 'base:ai_global', 1 of them from 1 mod bank\(s\)
forbidden_patterns: AI\.GLOBAL: [^\n]*(could not be read|do not compile|not one of the game's)
